title:
New launch:
*When you actually pay*

lines.say: You buy a 1.5 million dollar new launch. You don't pay it all at once.
5% when you get the option. Another 15% within 8 weeks. That's 300,000 dollars, mostly cash and CPF.
Then the bank pays as the building goes up: 10% at foundation, 10% at the frame.
5% each for walls, roof, doors and windows, then car parks and roads.
25% at TOP, when you get your keys. The last 15% at completion.
So your loan, and your monthly instalment, grows over the years, not on day one.

caption:
Buying a $1.5M new launch? You don't pay it all at once. 🏗️

5% at option, 15% within 8 weeks: $300,000, mostly cash and CPF.
Then as it's built: 10% foundation, 10% frame, 5% each for walls, roof, doors and windows, car parks and roads.
25% at TOP, the last 15% at completion.

So your loan and monthly instalment grow over the years, not on day one.

Normal progressive payment scheme for uncompleted private homes.
